notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Notice

Apologies for the recent update drought. Development and updates should return to a higher frequency.

Due to a sudden relocation (and reassignment) for work, a development platform and internet connection have been unavailable. As a result development and updates have been difficult. Having set up a new dev environment, update intervals will shorten and hopefully return to normal frequency soon.

notes.title: Update 16 - 8 - 17
notes.content:
Just changed:

The second half of world 1 has been moved to world 7.
Save files have been wiped.♀


♀ Save files may be wiped multiple times during Early Access. A system is being developed to avoid this unfortunate necessity.

What's next?
Most likely Mac support. Steamworks integration is being problematic on the mac osx build. Due to lack of access to a windows machine, mac support now has to be prioritized.
